defect: ADAPTER_RELEASE advanced on ready alone while CE could suppress valid; helper could release context before stalled child adapter retirement.
fix: Advance only ad_release_v && ad_release_r; export consumer_adapter_drained only RETIRE, reverse accepted, sink/core debt clear and !ad_retained.
wrapper_required: helper.source_reverse_v = parent.source_reverse_v && child.consumer_adapter_drained; parent.source_reverse_r = helper.source_reverse_r && child.consumer_adapter_drained. Gate both sides so no unmatched handshake. Original source metadata and full73 remain unchanged.
